_comment: Food banks removed from the map at their own request. Every pin whose id is the slug or starts with slug/, or whose website host matches, is dropped on every refresh (scripts/build.py), so discovery/Give Food can never re-add it.

foodbanks.name: Oldham Foodbank
foodbanks.reason: Referral-only delivery service; asked not to be listed (Dean, 22 Oct 2026)

foodbanks.name: Felix Multibank
foodbanks.reason: Supply hub: community organisations collect non-food items; does not serve the public (https://thefelixproject.org/felixs-multibank). Removed 22 Oct 2026 per Dean

foodbanks.name: Oxford Food Hub
foodbanks.reason: Surplus redistribution to charities only; 'not able to supply food directly to individuals' (https://oxfordfoodhub.org/getting-food/individuals/). Removed 22 Oct 2026 per Dean

foodbanks.name: Bradford Metropolitan Foodbank
foodbanks.reason: 'do not distribute food directly to those in need' - supplies registered third-party organisations only (https://bradfordfoodbank.com/). Removed 22 Oct 2026 per Dean
